jobs.title: Social Worker - Oncology (PRN)
jobs.description:
At Ivinson Memorial Hospital we are committed to excellence, trust, healing, and integrity. We pride ourselves in providing compassionate, world\-class care to our community. At Ivinson we offer a competitive total rewards package including; full medical, dental, and vision insurance, retirement plans, paid time off and tuition reimbursement opportunities. Ivinson aims to improve the care provided for our patients and create a work\-life balance for our employees by creating a culture of transparency, teamwork, accountability, and trust.

  


**E S S E N T I A L F U N C T I O N S**


* Assists in patient education as applicable including information to help patients understand diagnosis and treatment.
* Supports families and patient in their understanding upcoming and ongoing procedures.
* Coordinates transfer or referral arrangements.
* Offers assistance in access to drug replacements and state and community programs that offer financial assistance for those without insurance.
* Offers individual counseling, support groups and referrals to community counseling.
* Other duties as assigned.

  


**E D U C A T I O N**


* Master’s degree of Social Work required.

  


**E X P E R I E N C E**


* Minimum of one (1\) year experience as a social worker providing mental health services to patients and families in a hospital or other healthcare facility preferred.

  


**C R E D E N T I A L S**


* Must have a valid, current license to practice Social Work in the State of Wyoming and must be in good standing with the Mental Health Professions Licensing Board.
* Must have a current, valid Licensed Clinical Social Worker in the State of Wyoming and must be in good standing with the Mental Health Professions Licensing Board.
* Must have a valid, current Basic Life Support (BLS) certification or must obtain with 60 days of hire and maintain credentialing throughout employment at IMH.

  


**K N O W L E D G E , S K I L L S A N D A B I L I T I E S**


* Excellent customer service skills, including but not limited to: a friendly personality, tact, patience, empathy and a helpful, professional attitude both in person and on the telephone.
* Ability to effectively communicate with staff, managers and the general public verbally and in writing.
* Demonstrate effective listening skills.
* Excellent organization and time management skills and ability to establish priorities effectively.
* Possess exceptional problem solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively without immediate supervision.
* Ability to learn new computer software programs.
* Ability to recognize and protect confidential information.
* Demonstrate ethical and legal accountability for the position.

  



At Ivinson Memorial Hospital, we believe that our employees are our greatest investment. That’s why we are committed to fostering a supportive, empowering environment where every team member has the resources and opportunities to thrive. We know that providing world\-class healthcare starts with investing in our employees, ensuring they have the tools to grow, excel, and provide exceptional care.

  


**Our competitive and comprehensive total rewards package includes:**

  


**For benefits eligible employees:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off: take the time you need to recharge
* Retirement plans, including 403(b) matching
* Employer\-paid life and long\-term disability insurance: Peace of mind for you and your family

  


**For all employees:**


* Yearly work anniversary pay increases
* Education Reimbursement up to $5,000 annually
* Retirement plan participation
* Free certification classes: enhance your skills at no cost to you
* Health and Wellness discounts at local gyms
* Discounts at select mobile networks, local vendors, and Elitch Gardens
* Mental Health: 6 free confidential, in\-person counseling sessions offered by Pathways annually
* Financial Counseling: free services through WellCents to help you take control of your financial journey

* Student Loan Forgiveness: Ivinson Memorial Hospital is a qualifying employer for the federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) program

  



Please use this link for more information regarding our rewards package and benefits: Benefits Guide (https://www.flipsnack.com/ivinson/ivinson\-benefits\-brief\-2019/full\-view.html).

  



At Ivinson Memorial Hospital, we are more than just a workplace – we are a community where your growth and well\-being matter. Join us in making a difference in the lives of the Laramie community and help us provide world\-class care.

----------------

  

The Behavioral Health Specialist is responsible for direct patient care, safety, supervision and management of children and adolescents with identified behavioral health needs within diverse environments such as emergency services, medical units, and behavioral health programs. Performs duties under the direction of a licensed professional and implements behavioral treatment plans. Works alongside clinical professionals to provide a safe, supportive, and trauma informed environment.
  

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Provides direct patient care and management of children and adolescents while under the direction of a licensed professional, ensuring a positive, supportive, and structured environment. Intervenes and escalates safety concerns through appropriate channels.
* Maintains therapeutic rapport, unconditional positive regard, and a non\-punitive approach with patients independent of patient behaviors.
* Leads, monitors and collaborates on educational and therapeutic milieu groups for patients per unit expectations.
* Implements individual treatment plans and monitors treatment progress.

jobs.title: Associate Manager - Community Health Worker - Work at Home
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

***Position Summary***

***Associate Manager of Community Health Worker's***

***Location: Work at Home (anywhere USA)***

***Schedule: Mon\-Fri 08:00\-05:00MUST WORK EST HOURS)***


The Associate Manager will lead the implementation, oversight, and ongoing management of the Community Health Worker (CHW) Pilot focused on addressing health disparities and improving outcomes among Medicaid members with Type 2 diabetes or other chronic diagnoses.


This role is critical in responding to identified program needs, including high disease prevalence, elevated social determinants of health (SDoH) risk, and disproportionate concentration of high\-risk members in targeted counties. The Associate Manager will ensure the CHW program effectively improves member engagement, reduces avoidable utilization (ED visits and hospitalizations), and increases connection to primary care and community\-based resources.


The Associate Manager will oversee CHW staff, ensure alignment with interdisciplinary care teams, and drive achievement of pilot goals, including improved self\-management, enhanced member experience, and measurable improvements in quality and utilization metrics.

***Position Responsibilities***

* Oversee implementation and day\-to\-day operations of the CHW pilot, ensuring alignment with program design, goals, and timelines.
* Supervise CHWs, including caseload assignment (up to \~30 members per CHW), geographic alignment, and performance oversight.
* Ensure timely member outreach, engagement, and completion of required assessments (e.g., screening within 30 days, outreach attempts).
* Drive CHW activities focused on closing gaps in care, improving diabetes management, and increasing primary care utilization.
* Ensure CHWs effectively connect members to SDoH resources (housing, food, transportation) and manage closed\-loop referrals.
* Partner with interdisciplinary care teams (care management, behavioral health, pharmacy, providers) to coordinate member care plans.
* Lead case reviews, interdisciplinary rounds, and performance discussions to ensure member needs are addressed.
* Monitor pilot performance metrics including ED utilization, inpatient admissions, primary care utilization, and HEDIS/CMS quality measures.
* Identify risks, barriers to engagement, and operational gaps; implement corrective action plans.
* Oversee documentation quality and compliance within care management systems (e.g., Dynamo).
* Support pilot evaluation activities, including data reporting, analysis, and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
* Promote CHW workforce development through coaching, training, and retention strategies.
* Ensure adherence to Medicaid, contractual (DMAHS), and regulatory requirements.

***Required Qualifications***

* 3–5 years of experience in care management, population health, community health, or Medicaid program operations.
* Prior supervisory or team leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing programs targeting high\-risk or underserved populations.
* Strong understanding of SDoH, care coordination, and community\-based interventions.
* Experience managing performance metrics and driving quality and utilization outcomes.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and analytical skills

***License Requirements***

* Registered Nurse in state of residence
* or
* Independently licensed social worker/therapist in state of residence.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Experience leading or supporting CHW or community\-based pilot programs.
* Familiarity with NJ Medicaid program requirements, DMAHS, and HEDIS/quality metrics.
* Experience with diabetes management initiatives or chronic disease programs.
* Experience with care management systems (e.g., Dynamo) and community resource platforms.
* Background in program implementation, evaluation, or pilot design.
* Multilingual skills reflecting community population needs.

***Education Required***

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Social Work, Nursing, Health Administration, or related field (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**


40**Time Type**


Full time**Pay Range**


The typical pay range for this role is:


$88,374\.00 \- $190,344\.00
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short\-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above.

jobs.title: Remote (LICSW) Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker-West Virginia
jobs.description:
It is Adjuvant's vision to be the nation’s leading oncological behavioral health provider. Our mission is to inspire hope through advancing mental wellness to cancer patients, their families and caregivers. We are looking for empathetic, experienced mental health professionals to come along side us in this endeavor!

 **This is a fully remote position.**


**Pay: $60\-62/hr**

  

Through a respectful, constructive and energetic style, guided by the mission of the clinic, a therapist will seek to facilitate hope and change in the lives of their clients who have been affected by cancer. A therapist is responsible for accepting referrals and maintaining a client load (minimum 18 hours per week).

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


* Counsel clients or patients individually and/or within family sessions, to assist in overcoming dependencies, adjusting to life, or making changes.
* Make internal referrals to IOP if little to no improvement occurs within 8 weeks of OP therapy.
* Guide clients in the development of skills or strategies for dealing with their problems.
* Develop and implement treatment plans based on clinical experience and knowledge, establishing SMART goals with the patient. Treatment plans are to be developed 72 hours after intake and updated / modified every 4 weeks.
* Fill out and maintain client\-related paperwork, including client diagnostic records and progress notes. Progress notes are to be developed 48 hours after every session.
* Prepare and maintain all required treatment records and reports.
* Evaluate clients' physical or mental condition, based on review of client information.
* Collaborate with other staff members to perform clinical assessments or develop treatment plans within 2 days of establishing care with the existing patient.
* Refer patients, clients, or family members to community resources or to specialists as necessary.
* Learn about new developments in counseling by reading professional literature, attending courses and seminars, or establishing and maintaining contact with other social service agencies.

  


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Masters Degree from an accredited college or university
* Two years of professional level experience in a counselor setting
* Current and active Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker license in West Virginia is required
* Cross‑licensure in Texas is required for this role prior to starting.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 2\+ years experience in healthcare with oncology
* 1 year experience in Telehealth Settings

**Position Summary**
--------------------


YourADH (formally Vitra Adult Day Health) is seeking an experienced and compassionate **Adult Day Health Social Worker** to provide professional supervision, clinical consultation, and guidance for social work services within our Adult Day Health (ADH) program.


The Adult Day Health Social Worker provides ongoing professional oversight to promote high\-quality, ethical, culturally responsive, and client\-centered social work services. This role serves as a clinical and professional resource to the Case Manager regarding psychosocial assessments, care planning, referrals, documentation, complex client and family situations, community resources, and coordination with the interdisciplinary team.


The Social Worker will provide approximately **one hour of professional supervision per week** and consultation as needed. This position provides professional oversight, consultation, and guidance to support effective service delivery and regulatory compliance.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Provide regular professional supervision and consultation to the ADH Case Manager, including approximately one hour of supervision per week.
* Provide professional guidance related to psychosocial assessments, care plans, client\-centered goals, interventions, referrals, and follow\-up.
* Consult with the Case Manager regarding complex, high\-risk, or challenging client and family situations and recommend appropriate interventions.
* Review social work documentation and practices to promote accuracy, quality, confidentiality, and compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Support the Case Manager in coordinating social work services with clients, families, caregivers, healthcare providers, community agencies, and interdisciplinary team members.
* Provide guidance regarding community resources, healthcare services, social service agencies, benefits, and other referrals that address client needs.
* Support effective case management and care coordination for older adults, individuals with disabilities, and other vulnerable populations.
* Provide professional guidance regarding applicable Massachusetts Adult Day Health, Department of Public Health (DPH), MassHealth, and other regulatory requirements.
* Support the Case Manager and ADH program in maintaining complete and appropriate documentation, regulatory compliance, and audit readiness.
* Identify and communicate significant psychosocial concerns, safety risks, compliance issues, and recommendations to the ADH Program Director and appropriate members of the interdisciplinary team.
* Promote ethical social work practice, client advocacy, confidentiality, dignity, and culturally responsive care.
* Serve as a professional resource to the ADH team regarding psychosocial needs, social determinants of health, community resources, and care coordination.
* Collaborate effectively with nursing, medical, rehabilitation, behavioral health, case management, and other interdisciplinary team members.
* Maintain professional knowledge of relevant Massachusetts regulations, healthcare programs, community resources, and social work practices.


**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* **Master of Social Work (MSW) degree preferred.**
* **Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LICSW) required.**
* Demonstrated knowledge of professional social work practices, including psychosocial assessment, care planning, case management, referrals, advocacy, and client support.
* Experience working with older adults, individuals with disabilities, medically complex individuals, or other vulnerable populations preferred.
* Previous experience in social work supervision, clinical consultation, case management, or professional oversight preferred.
* Knowledge of community\-based healthcare and social service systems.
* Knowledge of Massachusetts Adult Day Health requirements and applicable healthcare and social service regulations.
* Strong understanding of confidentiality, professional ethics, documentation standards, and client rights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, organizational, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to provide constructive professional feedback and guidance to Case Management staff.
* Ability to exercise sound professional judgment when addressing complex client and family situations.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive client information appropriately.
* Demonstrated commitment to compassionate, person\-centered, trauma\-informed, and culturally responsive care.
* Ability to work collaboratively with clients, families, caregivers, providers, community agencies, and interdisciplinary team members.
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to review and evaluate electronic health records and documentation.

Experience or familiarity with:

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor (LCPC)/Clinical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Job Overview  
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor (LCPC) to join our dynamic mental health team. In this vital role, you will provide comprehensive psychotherapy and mental health services to diverse populations, including adults. Your expertise will help clients navigate complex emotional, behavioral, and psychological challenges, fostering resilience and promoting overall well\-being. As an LCPC, you will utilize evidence\-based practices and innovative treatment modalities to deliver personalized care through telehealth platforms. Your commitment to ethical standards and client\-centered approaches will make a meaningful difference in the lives of those you serve.

Responsibilities

* Conduct thorough mental health assessments and clinical evaluations using ICD\-9 and ICD\-10 coding standards to determine client needs.
* Develop individualized treatment plans incorporating evidence\-based practices such as cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), trauma\-focused therapy, psychodynamic therapy, and behavioral therapy.
* Provide individual, group, family, and child/youth counseling sessions utilizing techniques like motivational interviewing, grief counseling, art therapy, dance/movement therapy, and social work strategies.
* Manage crisis situations effectively through crisis intervention, crisis management protocols, and trauma\-informed care to ensure client safety.
* Maintain accurate clinical documentation adhering to HIPAA regulations, medical documentation standards, and clinical ethical guidelines within electronic health records (EHR/EMR).
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on case management, medical records review, and patient care coordination for clients with co\-occurring disorders or developmental disabilities.
* Engage in ongoing research and data collection to enhance clinical practices and contribute to quality improvement initiatives.

Requirements

* Valid licensure as a Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor (LCPC) or equivalent in the applicable state or region.
* Proven experience working with adolescents, individuals with disabilities—including autism—and diverse populations such as geriatrics or pediatrics.
* Strong knowledge of psychotherapeutic modalities including cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), psychodynamic therapy, trauma\-focused therapy, addiction counseling, and behavior management techniques.
* Experience working with individuals with co\-occurring disorders or complex mental health needs such as PTSD or chronic pain management.
* Proficiency in clinical documentation standards, ICD coding (ICD\-9/ICD\-10\), medical terminology, and telehealth therapy platforms.
* Ability to perform mental health assessments accurately using diagnostic tools aligned with HIPAA guidelines.
* Excellent communication skills for client engagement and collaboration with healthcare teams; experience in inpatient or outpatient settings is preferred.
* Commitment to ethical practice standards and ongoing professional development in behavioral health.

Join our team to make a lasting impact by providing compassionate care rooted in evidence\-based practices! We value energetic professionals who are eager to support clients’ mental health journeys through innovative therapies and collaborative approaches. Your expertise will help foster healthier communities while advancing your career in a supportive environment dedicated to excellence in clinical care.

Pay: From $60\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote
